rationale: The agent verified the user properly using full name and zip via the lookup tool, limiting actions to the authenticated user’s account. It listed both pending orders and the current shipping address, then sought explicit confirmation before changing order addresses. It executed the address updates correctly for both orders and confirmed completion. For the jigsaw change, it confirmed intent and payment method before modifying the item, checked available variants, selected the 500-piece beginner option (the least pieces and easiest difficulty available), performed the modification on the pending order using PayPal, and reported the refund. The shipping status was accurately reported as pending based on tool data. There were no unsupported claims, no actions on another account, and no writes without confirmation. While the profile (user) address was not updated, the customer only requested updates to the orders, so this is not a policy violation.
